name: The Good Book VN
detailed_description:
The Good Book VN is a Visual Novel using text and pictures and theme music

It contains over 50 page's of rich story text Crime and Punishment Fiction set in uk England in the 1980's

A story about young teenager that chose the wrong path in life.

May contain Themes of adult nature may contain swear words or references to: Crime and Punishment , Gangs and Violence, Drugs Guns and Prison Time.
Life Style Advice, Finding jesus Christ and spotting the devil that tells lies and his plan for you

1980's

England uk

Rich story text

Visual Novel

Don't choose the gun or the knife ,choose your life - Thank you for supporting my work's

Press Next then Go to Navigate the page's of the Visual Novel or Main to return to beginning

Game is to run on Wndows 64 platform only

"Feel free to choose your own music while reading the novel."
